name: jarrydh-agents
description: Reusable Claude Code agents and skills

plugins.name: four-pass-review
plugins.description: Four-pass code review: completeness, correctness, compliance and consistency reviewer agents run in parallel, then merged into one ranked report

plugins.name: test-gap-writer
plugins.description: Turns code-review findings into tests: one test-writer agent per finding writes the smallest test that proves it, runs it, and reports whether it reproduced the defect. A hook confines the writer to test files

plugins.name: migration-safety
plugins.description: Reviews database migrations for what breaks in production: old code against the new schema during a deploy, table locks, data loss, constraints existing rows violate, and missing rollbacks. Launches nothing when a change has no migrations

plugins.name: change-impact
plugins.description: Maps what a change touches and what reaches it: callers, routes, scheduled tasks, queued jobs, event listeners, tests that reach it and changed code none do, data and contracts. Facts, not a review. Launches nothing when only docs or tests changed

plugins.name: engineering-review
plugins.description: Works out which of this marketplace's plugins a change needs, from the files it touches and with no model, and shows the plan: what would run, what is skipped and why, and what to offer afterwards

plugins.name: regression-hunter
plugins.description: Checks whether a change undoes what the repository's history already learned: removes a fix's guard, re-introduces reverted code, loosens a regression test, or leaves a usual partner file behind. Launches nothing when the history has nothing to say
